missed_every_seed@5.text: The plumber swapped the cartridge in the kitchen faucet, and the drip that kept me up at night is finally gone.
The smoke alarm in the stairwell chirped every forty seconds until I changed its nine-volt battery.
I booked a chimney sweep for the first Tuesday of November; he charges sixty pounds.
My car's rear left tyre keeps losing pressure; the garage says it is a slow puncture near the valve.
Biscuit went missing for two days and turned up in the neighbour's garage, hungry but fine.
The optician said my prescription changed and I ordered new glasses with thinner lenses for 240 pounds.
The credit card was cloned; the bank refunded the 480 pounds spent in a Manchester electronics shop.
I bought a second-hand Yamaha keyboard for 180 pounds from a seller in Kettering.
I set up a Raspberry Pi running Pi-hole to block ads across the home network.
The smart thermostat lost its schedule after the firmware update and heated the flat to 26 degrees overnight.
I got food poisoning from the prawn curry at the Blue Lagoon and lost two days to it.
There was a power cut across the whole estate for six hours on Tuesday night.
The greenhouse glass panel blew out in the storm and I replaced it with polycarbonate.
The library fined me 8 pounds for the overdue atlas.
